user.title: Samsung appliance (local)
user.description:
Enter the appliance's IP address and the Samsung AC14K_M CA certificate and private key.

The CA is only needed for the first appliance — later ones reuse it automatically. Leave the token blank to pair now; supply one only if you already have it.

pair.title: Press the button on the appliance
pair.description:
Home Assistant will ask {host} for a token and listen for its reply.

**Before you continue — turn Child Lock OFF.** Samsung disables Smart Control entirely while it is engaged. The panel still beeps on every press, so a locked machine looks exactly like a working one that is ignoring you.

Submit below, then within three minutes press **Smart Control** on the appliance once.

On some washers that button must first be *held* for about three seconds to light its indicator. Do not keep holding — if `AP` appears on the display it has entered onboarding mode and left your Wi‑Fi; release and let it rejoin.

error.cannot_connect: No response on port 8888. If this appliance has no port 8888 open it is probably the newer CoAP‑DTLS generation, which needs the LocalThings integration instead.
error.invalid_certificate: That certificate and key could not be loaded, or they are not a matching pair.
error.pairing_failed: No token arrived. The confirmation button was not pressed while a pairing window was open, or Child Lock is still engaged.

abort.already_configured: This appliance is already set up.
